Overview of Current Cricket Fixtures

Recent reports and score updates outline the status of various multi-day cricket matches across different competitions. Fans following the sport can check official broadcaster pages and sports news portals for real-time updates, venue details, and complete scorecards.

Featured Matches and Status Updates

Based on available schedule data and reported scores, several matches are either currently in play or have concluded their latest day of action with stumps called:

  • Queensland Bulls vs Victoria: In play on Day 4 (31 October to 3 November). Victoria scored 307 all out in 90.4 overs, while Queensland Bulls posted 280 all out from 103.5 overs. Victoria reached 167 for 9 from 77.1 overs, holding a 194-run lead with 1 wicket remaining.
  • Uttar Pradesh vs Baroda: Stumps called on Day 2 of 4 (2 to 5 November). Baroda reached 269 for 6 from 87 overs, with Uttar Pradesh yet to bat.
  • Goa vs Bihar: Stumps called on Day 2 of 4 (2 to 5 November). Goa finished at 288 for 6 from 87 overs, and Bihar has yet to bat.
  • Vidarbha vs Madhya Pradesh: Stumps called on Day 2 of 4 (2 to 5 November). Madhya Pradesh were dismissed for 209 in 66.1 overs. Vidarbha reached 56 for 4 from 23 overs, trailing by 153 runs with 6 wickets remaining.
  • Assam vs Karnataka: Stumps called on Day 2 of 4 (2 to 5 November). Assam were bowled out for 135 in 48.1 overs. Karnataka responded strongly, reaching 180 for 2 from 36 overs to lead by 45 runs with 8 wickets in hand.
  • Himachal Pradesh vs Rajasthan: Stumps called on Day 2 of 4 (2 to 5 November). Himachal Pradesh were dismissed for 153 in 40 overs, and Rajasthan were restricted to 78 all out in 30.3 overs. In their second phase of action, Rajasthan reached 8 for 0 in 1 over, trailing by 67 runs with 10 wickets remaining.

Upcoming and Scheduled Fixtures

  • Dolphins vs Western Province Cobras: Scheduled to begin at 16:00 at the Hollywoodbets Kingsmead venue in Durban.
  • West Indies A vs England Lions: Scheduled to start at 17:00 at the Conaree Sports Club in Conaree.
